description: 已观察到的翻译质量退化案例，供人工对照及后续回归测试使用；original 为原 ONNX 输出，linguaspark 为 LinguaSpark 输出，fast 为 ONNX 候选词表快速模式输出。
limitations: 这些是筛选出的退化样本，不代表总体错误率；记录的是实际输出，不是所有未来实现必须逐字匹配的标准答案。保留原始标点。

cases.issue: 三角龙被误译为三头肌
cases.reference: 三角龙的牙齿不仅能咬碎树叶，还能咬碎非常坚硬的树枝和树根。
cases.source: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.
cases.original: 三角龙的牙齿不仅能压碎树叶,还能压碎非常坚硬的树枝和根部。
cases.linguaspark: 三头肌的牙齿不仅能压碎树叶,甚至能压碎非常坚硬的枝条和根部。
cases.fast: 三头肌的牙齿不仅能压碎树叶,甚至能压碎非常坚硬的枝条和根部。

cases.issue: 盟友变成敌人的关系与冷战起因被破坏
cases.reference: 战争结束两年后，曾经的盟友如今成了敌人，冷战随即开始。
cases.source: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.
cases.original: 战争结束两年后,昔日的盟友如今成了敌人,冷战由此爆发。
cases.linguaspark: 战争结束两年后,昔日第二任盟友如今也与冷战爆发。
cases.fast: 战争结束两年后,昔前盟友如今也与冷战爆发为敌,冷战也爆发了。

cases.issue: 除以十二被误译为十二分之二等表达
cases.reference: 因此，这种格式的宽高比（除以 12 得到最简单的整数比）便是 3:2。
cases.source: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
cases.original: 因此,这种格式的宽高比(除以十二以获得最简单的整数比)据称为3:2。
cases.linguaspark: 因此,这种格式的宽高比(按十二分位进行,以获得最简单的全数比)是3:2。
cases.fast: 因此,这种格式的宽高比(按十二分之二来获得最简单的全数比)据称为3:2。

cases.issue: 肝内胆管癌被译为错误拼词
cases.reference: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.
cases.source: 宣布的死因是肝内胆管癌。
cases.original: The cause of death was intrahepatic bile duct cancer.
cases.linguaspark: The declared cause of death is intrahepatial chonosal cancer.
cases.fast: The cause of death was intrahepatial cholerial cancer.

cases.issue: 中央邦地名被误译
cases.reference: The Madhya Pradesh Police recovered the stolen laptop and mobile phone.
cases.source: 中央邦警方追回了被盗的笔记本电脑和手机。
cases.original: Madhya Pradesh police recovered stolen laptops and mobile phones.
cases.linguaspark: The Central Bater police recovered the stolen laptop and cell phone.
cases.fast: The Central Bay police recovered the stolen laptop and cell phone.

cases.issue: 尚未准备好的人这一主语被弱化
cases.reference: 严寒也许是没有准备的人将面临的唯一真正的危险。
cases.source: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.
cases.original: 寒冷天气或许是那些尚未做好准备的人将面临的唯一真正危险。
cases.linguaspark: 寒冷天气或许是尚未做好准备的唯一真正危险。
cases.fast: 寒冷天气或许是尚未做好准备时唯一真正面临的危险。

cases.issue: 菲律宾政府实体被漏译
cases.reference: 他们被迫向美国殖民政权纳税，用于支付大部分开支，以及通过华尔街银行以菲律宾政府名义发行的债券的利息。
cases.source: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.
cases.original: 他们被迫向美国殖民政权缴纳税款,以支付大部分支出,并通过华尔街银行集团以菲律宾政府名义发行的债券利息。
cases.linguaspark: 他们被迫向美国殖民政权缴纳税款,以支付主要支出,并通过华尔街银行的名义发行债券的利息。
cases.fast: 他们被迫向美国殖民政权缴纳税款,以支付主要支出,并通过华尔街银行的名义发行债券的利息。

cases.issue: 统治关系被破坏为不完整表达
cases.reference: 它由“维希”法国人统治。这些法国人在 1940 年与德国人达成了和平协议，不反抗侵略者，而是和他们合作。
cases.source: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
cases.original: 它由“维希”法国人统治。这些法国人曾在1940年与德国人实现和平,并与入侵者合作,而非与他们作战。
cases.linguaspark: 它由“维希”法属人。这些法国人曾在1940年与德国人和平相处,并与入侵者合作,而非与他们作战。
cases.fast: 它由“维希”法属人。这些法国人曾在1940年与德国人和平相处,并与入侵者合作,而非与他们作战。

cases.issue: 防止虐待动物协会名称被误译
cases.reference: 英国皇家防止虐待动物协会 (RSPCA ) 新南威尔士州总督察大卫·奥沙纳西 (David O'Shannessy) 告诉 ABC，在澳大利亚监管和视察屠宰场应该是司空见惯的事。
cases.source: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.
cases.original: 新南威尔士州防止虐待动物协会(RSPCA)首席检查员大卫·奥尚内西向澳大利亚广播公司表示,对屠宰场的监控和检查在澳大利亚应十分普遍。
cases.linguaspark: 新南威尔士州皇家保护协会首席检查员大卫·奥尚内西向澳大利亚广播公司表示,对屠宰场的监控和检查在澳大利亚应司空见惯。
cases.fast: 新南威尔士州皇家保护协会首席检查员大卫·奥尚内西向澳大利亚广播公司表示,对屠宰场的监控和检查在澳大利亚应司空见惯。

cases.issue: 赛车手被误译为赛跑运动员
cases.reference: 在赛道上热身时，伦茨 (Lenz) 从自行车上摔了下来，然后被跟在后面的赛车手泽维尔·扎亚特 (Xavier Zayat) 撞到。
cases.source: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.
cases.original: 在热身时,伦茨从自行车上摔了下来,随后被另一位赛车手泽维尔·扎亚特撞倒。
cases.linguaspark: 在热身时,伦茨从自行车上摔下,随后被同为赛跑运动员的泽维尔·扎亚特撞倒。
cases.fast: 在热身时,伦茨从自行车上摔下,随后被另一位赛跑运动员泽维尔·扎亚特撞倒。

cases.issue: 因奢华著称被误译为因奢华高发
cases.reference: 它作为奢侈品中心的声誉始于公元 400 年左右，一直延续到公元 1100 年左右。
cases.source: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
cases.original: 它因奢华而著称,始于公元400年左右,一直持续到公元1100年左右。
cases.linguaspark: 它因奢华而高高在上,始于约公元400年,一直持续到公元1100年左右。
cases.fast: 它因奢华而高发,始于约公元400年,一直持续到公元1100年左右。

cases.issue: 敌对火力导致坠机的因果表达被破坏
cases.reference: 坠机发生在高海拔山区，据称是敌方火力所致。
cases.source: The crash occurred high up in mountainous terrain, and is believed to have been the result of hostile fire.
cases.original: 坠机事件发生在山区,据信是敌对火力所致。
cases.linguaspark: 坠机事件发生在山区,据信是敌对火力的发生。
cases.fast: 坠机事件发生在山区,据信是敌对火力的发生。

cases.issue: 连胜15场被误译为15-court win
cases.reference: The final score was a one-point victory, 21 to 20, ending the All Blacks' 15 game winning streak.
cases.source: 最后结果是一分险胜，比分为 21 比 20，结束了全黑队连胜 15 场的局面。
cases.original: The result was a narrow win, a score of 21 to 20, ending the all-black team's 15-game winning streak.
cases.linguaspark: The final result was a narrow win, with a score of 21 to 20, ending the all-black team's 15-court win.
cases.fast: The result was a narrow win, a score of 21 to 20, ending the all-black team's 15-court win.

cases.issue: 照例撒谎被译为不通顺的lied as a lying
cases.reference: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".
cases.source: 媒体公司照例撒谎以掩盖其目的，声称这是为了“防止盗版”。
cases.original: Media companies routinely lie to cover up their purpose, claiming it is to “prevent piracy.”
cases.linguaspark: Media companies have lied as a regular example to cover up their purpose, claiming that it was meant to “prevent piracy.”
cases.fast: Media companies have lied as a lying to cover up their purpose, claiming it was to “prevent piracy.”

cases.issue: 坐进汽车被译为错误拼词Personting
cases.reference: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.
cases.source: 坐进自己的车，开启一段漫长的公路之旅，本身就有一种简单纯粹的吸引力。
cases.original: Getting into your car and starting a long road trip has a simple and pure attraction in itself.
cases.linguaspark: Personting in your car and embarking on a long road journey has a simple and pure attraction in itself.
cases.fast: Personting in your car and embarking on a long road journey has a simple and pure attraction in itself.

cases.issue: 山峰高耸被误译为tossing
cases.reference: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.
cases.source: 高耸于马丘比丘北端的这座陡峭的山峰，常常会成为许多遗址照片的背景。
cases.original: This steep mountain, towering to the north end of Machu Picchu, often forms the backdrop for many of the site’s photographs.
cases.linguaspark: This steep mountain, to the north end of Machu Picchu, often becomes the backdrop for many of the site’s photographs.
cases.fast: This steep mountain, tossing north of Machu Picchu, often becomes the backdrop for many of the site’s photographs.

cases.issue: 光合作用被译为错误拼词photosyntsy
cases.reference: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
cases.source: 植物通过光合作用从阳光中获取养分。它们还能提供荫凉。
cases.original: Plants get nutrients from sunlight through photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
cases.linguaspark: Plants get nutrients from sunlight through photosyntsy. They also provide shade.
cases.fast: Plants get nutrients from sunlight through photosyntsy. They also provide shade.

cases.issue: 提示哪条船在找人被译为错误拼词并改变关系
cases.reference: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.
cases.source: 试着和尽可能多的人聊天。过一段时间，每个人都会认识你，他们会提示你哪条船在找人。
cases.original: Try talking to as many people as possible. After a while, everyone will know you and they'll tell you which boat is looking for someone.
cases.linguaspark: Try talking to as many people as possible. After a while, everyone will know you and they'll be teating which boat you're looking for.
cases.fast: Try talking to as many people as possible. After a while, everyone will know you and they'll be teating which boat you're looking for.

cases.issue: 武藏号被误译为USW
cases.reference: If confirmed, the find completes Allen's eight-year search for the Musashi.
cases.source: 如果这一发现得到证实，艾伦对武藏号 8 年的搜寻工作就大功告成了。
cases.original: If this discovery is confirmed, Allen's eight-year search for the Musashi has come to an end.
cases.linguaspark: If this discovery is confirmed, Allen's eight-year search for the trumpet has come to an end.
cases.fast: If this discovery is confirmed, Allen's eight-year search for the USW is over.

cases.issue: 马镫被误译为马鞍
cases.reference: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
cases.source: 马镫悬挂在马鞍两侧，用来支撑骑手的双脚。
cases.original: The stirrups are suspended on both sides of the saddle to support the rider’s feet.
cases.linguaspark: The saddle hangs on both sides of the saddle to support the rider's feet.
cases.fast: The saddle hangs on both sides of the saddle to support the rider’s feet.

cases.issue: 捶打和碾压被译为错误拼词tashing或rashing
cases.reference: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.
cases.source: 它可以拉成细丝，用于缠绕和编结。也可以捶打或碾成片状。
cases.original: It can be pulled into filaments for winding and knotting. It can also be tamped or rolled into pieces.
cases.linguaspark: It can be pulled into filaments for winding and tuning. It can also be tuned or flaked.
cases.fast: It can be pulled into filaments for winding and knotting. It can also be tashing or rashing into pieces.

cases.issue: 人马座星系被译为错误拼词Sagottian
cases.reference: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy.
cases.source: 完成的工作大多是理论性的，但编写程序的目的，是为了模拟对人马座星系的观测。
cases.original: Most of the work done was theoretical, but the purpose of the program was to simulate observations of the Sagittarius galaxy.
cases.linguaspark: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the purpose of the program was to simulate observations of the Sagotisma galaxy.
cases.fast: Most of the work done was theoretical, but the purpose of the program was to simulate observations of the Sagottian galaxy.

cases.issue: 能登机场名称与实体被破坏；原引擎地名音译也不准确
cases.reference: Some roads have been damaged, railway service interrupted in the affected areas, and the Noto Airport in Ishikawa prefecture remains closed.
cases.source: 一些道路受到了损坏，受影响地区的铁路服务中断，石川（Ishikawa）县的能登机场仍然处于关闭状态。
cases.original: Some roads were damaged, rail services were disrupted in the affected areas, and the Ishikawa Prefecture’s Nengden Airport remained closed.
cases.linguaspark: Some roads were damaged, rail services were disrupted in the affected areas, and the Ishikawa Prefecture’s endway was still closed.
cases.fast: Some roads were damaged, rail services were disrupted in the affected areas, and the Ishikawa county’s endway was still closed.

cases.issue: 消极情绪被译为错误拼词venity
cases.reference: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
cases.source: 每个人都能达到开悟的境界，而实现它的唯一阻碍是我们自己的紧张感和消极情绪。
cases.original: Everyone can reach the realm of enlightenment, and the only obstacle to achieving it is our own feelings of tension and negativity.
cases.linguaspark: Everyone can reach the realm of enlightenment, and the only obstacle to achieving it is our own tension and negative emotions.
cases.fast: Everyone can reach the realm of enlightenment, and the only obstacle to achieving it is our own feelings of tension and venity.

cases.issue: 南方古猿被译为错误拼词Australopic thepenics
cases.reference: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.
cases.source: 他们的祖先南方古猿没有直立行走的习惯。
cases.original: Their ancestors, Australopithecus, did not have the habit of walking upright.
cases.linguaspark: Their ancestors, Australopic thepenics, had no habit of walking upright.
cases.fast: Their ancestors, Australopic thepenics, did not have the habit of walking upright.
